mission: Bring @beep/box under an explicit type instantiation budget by scoping its generated SDK surface to declared demand (9 of 85 managers) with a driver-local manager manifest and transitive model-closure pruning, and record the staged levers (explicit type annotations, then per-manager split) to fire only if pruning misses budget.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

targetPackage.name: @beep/box
targetPackage.scaffoldNote: Driver shipped in merge commit f306e8ca5b via goals/box-driver. This packet changes the generator's input scope only.

baseline.measurementMethod: Temp tsconfig extending the package tsconfig with "include": [] and "files": ["src/_generated/Box.models.gen.ts"], compilerOptions composite:false incremental:false noEmit:true, then bunx tsc -p <tmp> --extendedDiagnostics. NOTE: "files" does NOT clear an inherited "include".

keyDecisions.decision: @beep/box's generated surface is demand-scoped, not vendor-complete. The generator consumes an explicit manager allowlist and emits only the transitively reachable model closure. Initial allowlist is strictly demand-only: avatars, chunkedUploads, downloads, events, files, folders, uploads, users, zipDownloads.
keyDecisions.rationale: 03-driver-boundaries.md requires drivers not be product-aware; it never requires vendor-complete coverage. 76 of 85 managers are type-checked and documented on every proof for zero callers. Regrow is one manifest line plus bun run generate.

keyDecisions.decision: The manager allowlist lives at packages/drivers/box/scripts/box.surface.ts. Extra model roots are discovered by scanning only the driver's own hand-written src/ for M.* references. The generator never scans the monorepo for @beep/box importers.
keyDecisions.rationale: Auto-deriving the surface from product code would make the driver product-aware and would make generated output change when unrelated slices change. The manifest edit is the deliberate review chokepoint.

keyDecisions.decision: A manager outside the allowlist simply does not exist on BoxGeneratedOperations. No catch-all operation surface and no BoxUnsupportedManager runtime error.
keyDecisions.rationale: Keeps the surface fully typed and prevents an unsupported call shipping to production. The regrow procedure is documented in the driver README.

keyDecisions.decision: Budget: <=750K MARGINAL instantiations for any single generated file (total minus the schema-import floor) and <=3M absolute package-wide, measured by the canonical temp-tsconfig method. Levers fire in order and only on a budget miss: (1) prune, (2) generator-emitted explicit type annotations, (3) per-manager split.
keyDecisions.rationale: Splitting redistributes mass across checker threads but does not reduce total instantiations; annotations reduce work by capping inference, a mechanism already proven by withCodecStatics (removing statics INCREASED instantiations 41%). Attack mass before distribution, and stop as soon as budget is met. Marginal cost is the only term that responds to work on this package.
keyDecisions.amended: 2026-08-01 (P2): originally '<=1.5M instantiations per generated file, absolute'. A file importing only @beep/identity, @beep/schema, and effect/Schema with one trivial schema costs 1,649,265 instantiations, so the original per-file threshold sat below the floor and was unachievable by construction; post-prune the file is 83% floor. Restated in marginal terms. The <=3M absolute package budget was sound as written and was met.

keyDecisions.decision: Re-measurement is required whenever the manager manifest changes and is recorded in that PR. No CI lane enforces the budget.
keyDecisions.rationale: The manifest is a single-file chokepoint, so a slow full-typecheck CI lane buys little over reviewing the one file that moves. Promote to a gate only if mass demonstrably creeps back unnoticed.

keyDecisions.decision: @beep/ui (~3.5M instantiations) is out of scope and gets its own packet after lever 2 is proven here.
keyDecisions.rationale: Its mass is hand-written component/prop generics, so no allowlist lever exists. Only the measurement method and the return-type-caps-inference lever transfer.

keyDecisions.decision: No standards/architecture/DECISIONS.md entry; this is recorded as a driver-level decision in this manifest and the driver README.
keyDecisions.rationale: Follows the precedent of goals/box-driver's pragmatic-generated-fidelity, explicitly recorded as a driver-level decision not promoted to DECISIONS.md. No architecture-wide doctrine changes.

measuredDeadEnds.result: <=2.4% movement; removing statics INCREASED instantiations 41% because the explicit wrapper return type caps inference.

phaseStatusMeaning.pending: Not started. Phases carrying a conditional `exit` are built only if the preceding phase misses the instantiation budget.

phases.name: Baseline Measurement
phases.exit: Baseline instantiation numbers for Box.models.gen.ts and the whole package committed to research/measurements.md.

phases.name: Prune (lever 1)
phases.exit: Generator emits only the 9 allowlisted managers plus the reachable model closure; consumers typecheck with no edits outside the driver; re-measured. Under budget -> skip to P5 and leave P3/P4 unbuilt.

phases.name: Explicit Type Annotations (lever 2)
phases.exit: NOT BUILT - P2 met budget, so this lever was never fired. Was conditional on P2 misses budget. Generator emits explicit type annotations for schema exports; re-measured against the same budget.

phases.name: Per-Manager Split (lever 3)
phases.exit: NOT BUILT - P2 met budget, so this lever was never fired. Was conditional on P3 misses budget, and only after a throwaway half-split measurement confirms a split moves total instantiations rather than just wall-clock.

phases.name: Documentation & Closeout
phases.exit: Driver README documents manifest + regrow + re-measurement obligation; box-driver supersede note landed; packet lifecycle flipped and closeout reflection landed in the same PR.

stopConditions: Stop and report if the post-prune measurement is over budget; P3 requires a design pass on S.Class annotation extraction, not automatic continuation.
Stop if pruning requires source edits outside packages/drivers/box to keep consumers typechecking; that means the demand analysis was wrong and must be re-derived.
Do not lead with a per-manager split; it redistributes mass rather than reducing it.
Do not remove withCodecStatics or $I.annoteSchema; both are measured dead ends and statics are inference-capping.
statusNote: Decision doc authored and shipped in the same PR as the implementation. Lever 1 (demand-scoped prune) met budget on its own: package 7,472,755 -> 2,503,112 instantiations (-66.5%), Box.models.gen.ts marginal cost 3,160,295 -> 338,580 (-89.3%). Levers 2 and 3 recorded as designed-but-unbuilt.
supersedesNote: Supersedes the mission framing of goals/box-driver ('full-surface, generated') only. Contradicts none of its 10 locked keyDecisions; generate-from-sdk-types and pragmatic-generated-fidelity continue to bind. Only the generator's input scope changes.

outcome.leversFired: prune only (lever 1); annotations and split stay designed-but-unbuilt
outcome.budgetAmendment: The original <=1.5M absolute per-file budget sat below the 1,649,265 schema-import floor and was unachievable by construction. Restated as <=750K marginal (total minus floor). Package budget <=3M absolute unchanged and met.
outcome.attribution: apps/professional-desktop has 168 typecheck errors both before and after this change (byte-identical error sets) - inherited, not introduced. @beep/box and @beep/documents-server are clean.
outcome.incidentalFix: resolveBoxPaths hardcoded repoRoot/node_modules/box-node-sdk, which does not exist in a git worktree; it now walks up for the installed SDK.
